ModMetaData.name: Invisible Display Case Continued
ModMetaData.author: Icepickgma
ModMetaData.description:
Decorate your base!
Adds an invisible display case using NightmareCore that can be placed over top of anything.
Pawns cannot use items stored inside, so it's only for a cosmetic appeal.
In NightmareCore settings enable the "Allow all items to be displayed" option to put all kinds of things inside.
Warning: placing buildings inside may cause errors? Not tested fully.
If you find an item that doesn't won't let you put it inside, give me the name of the mod it comes from and I may make a patch for it.
